requirements.title: Repository-manager materializes an approved proposal into a commit
requirements.remaining: The materialization service is implemented on the default branch (repository_manager/materialization/) and its behavior is proven with test doubles for the external ports (tests/materialization/test_service.py). It is not reachable yet: there is no real approval authority or receipt store to bind it to, and no command exposes it. Remaining: bind real implementations of those two ports, expose one typed operation, and prove this requirement through that entry point.
